verdict.rationale: Box AI is documented to ask questions of, summarize, and extract metadata from files stored in Box. Box Hubs let users index curated content and get answers from Box AI, and the product site says users can co-create content with AI and summarize, extract, generate, and query content with permissions intact. Most of this evidence describes the developer API, though, rather than the in-product end-user experience. missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive AI suggestions (not just answers or summaries), detailed docs on the in-app end-user Box AI experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.
